subtitle_zh: 阵位、装备、兵器、敌情与奇遇，一页备战。
subtitle_en: Posts, gear, weapons, threats, and encounters for the next watch.

scout.tip_zh: 数量多、生命低；用范围与穿透兵器压住第一波。
scout.tip_en: Many and fragile; area and piercing weapons control the opening wave.

ronin.tip_zh: 中速近战，常混在斥候后推进；保持侧向移动，别被包夹。
ronin.tip_en: Medium-speed melee that follows the scouts; keep sidestepping so they cannot surround you.

shield.tip_zh: 有 18% 减伤且移动慢；用击退、穿透和灼烧磨开盾线。
shield.tip_en: Slow with 18% damage reduction; wear the shield line down with knockback, pierce, and burn.

gun.tip_zh: 近距离单发火铳，横向移动即可躲开；贴近后它装填很慢。
gun.tip_en: A single close-range shot: strafe to dodge it, then close while it reloads.

archer.tip_zh: 射程最远；优先借掩体贴近，先清远程再收近战。
archer.tip_en: Longest reach; use cover to close in and clear the ranged line before the melee.

banner.tip_zh: 携带支援光环，优先击杀；旗倒后周围压力会明显下降。
banner.tip_en: A support aura makes it a priority target; the pressure drops when the banner falls.

general.tip_zh: 2:00 起随龙鳞事件出现；冲锋前横向位移，别沿直线后退。
general.tip_en: Appears with the 2:00 dragon-scale event; sidestep the charge instead of backing away in a straight line.

daimyo.tip_zh: 15:30 Boss，高血高伤；保留龙鳞清屏与爆发，绕背躲冲锋。
daimyo.tip_en: The 15:30 boss: high health and damage. Save a dragon-scale clear and burst, and circle behind its charge.

tideland.tip_zh: 开阔滩涂，潮沟会切割追击线；适合绕行拉怪，但不要在浅水区停步。
tideland.tip_en: Open flats and tidal cuts break pursuit lines; kite around them, but never stop in the shallows.

watergate.tip_zh: 水门与桥面形成瓶颈；把敌潮拉进窄口，再用范围兵器收割。
watergate.tip_en: Water gates and bridges form chokepoints; draw the tide into a narrow mouth and harvest with area weapons.

crossstreet.tip_zh: 敌血与敌速更高，刷新反而更少；沿十字主街机动，别在巷口被合围。
crossstreet.tip_en: Enemies are faster and tougher but spawn less often; move along the crossroads and avoid being boxed in at lane mouths.

facts_zh: 宁村所与永昌堡相隔一百七十余年，同守浙南沿海。
汤和巡海筑所、王德移师殉国、王氏聚族筑堡，串起两堡记忆。
方志、堡史与地方信俗，各自保存着这段海防往事。
facts_en: Ningcun and Yongchang stand more than 170 years apart on the same coast.
Tang He's garrison, Wang De's final march, and the Wang clan's fort bind their memories together.
Gazetteers, fort histories, and local traditions each preserve part of this coastal past.

left.lead_zh: 汤和主持筑所城，留制度与海防网络。
left.lead_en: Tang He built the garrison and left behind an institutional coastal network.
points_zh: 洪武十九年，汤和筑宁村所；洪武二十年所城成。
“寓兵于民”把乡兵、屯田与海防接到一起。
宁村汤和庙原名“东瓯襄武王汤公庙”，与永昌堡东瓯王庙不是同一座庙。
points_en: In 1386 Tang He built Ningcun garrison; it was completed in 1387.
The 'soldiers among the people' system linked militia, farmland, and coastal defence.
Ningcun's Tang He temple was originally the Dong'ou Xiangwu Wang Tang Gong temple; it is not Yongchang's Dong'ou King temple.
left.source_ref: 《汤和信俗·抵御倭患第一人》；《意绘抗倭英雄汤和》

bridge.body_zh: 嘉靖三十七年四月十九日，王德为解温州府城之围，移师宁村策应。四月二十日，他从宁村方向驰援，在金岙遭伏殉国。
bridge.body_en: On 19 April 1558 Wang De moved to Ningcun to relieve Wenzhou. On 20 April he rode out from Ningcun and was ambushed and killed at Jin'ao.
bridge.source_ref: 《永昌堡：十三进士与抗倭纪略》

right.lead_zh: 王沛、王德死后，王氏筑堡；王叔杲留下《沿海事宜》。
right.lead_en: After Wang Pei and Wang De died, the Wang clan built the fort; Wang Shugao left the 'Coastal Affairs' assessment.
points_zh: 嘉靖三十七年至三十八年，王氏筑永昌堡。
王叔杲《沿海事宜》评估宁村渡口、宁村马道与国初卫所部署。
1648 年宁村所被攻破，永昌堡独守八十余日，形成官堡/民堡对照。
points_en: The Wang clan built Yongchang Fort in 1558–1559.
Wang Shugao's 'Coastal Affairs' assessed Ningcun's ferry, horse road, and early-Ming garrison layout.
In 1648 Ningcun fell while Yongchang held out for over eighty days, a contrast between official and civic forts.
right.source_ref: 《永昌堡：十三进士与抗倭纪略》

timeline.zh: 王德移师宁村，次日殉国金岙
timeline.en: Wang De moves to Ningcun; dies at Jin'ao the next day

timeline.zh: 宁村破，永昌独守八十余日
timeline.en: Ningcun falls; Yongchang holds for over eighty days

timeline.zh: 汤和诞辰七百周年，五龙拼“天下太平”
timeline.en: Tang He's 700th anniversary; five dragon lanterns spell peace

do_not_claim_zh: 永昌堡东瓯王庙祀汉东瓯王驺摇，与宁村汤和庙各有香火；1559 年的守夜故事，承接的是汤和海防遗绪与王氏筑堡记忆。
do_not_claim_en: Yongchang's Dong'ou King temple honours the Han-era Zoyao, while Ningcun remembers Tang He at its own shrine. The 1559 watch carries forward Tang He's coastal legacy and the Wang clan's fort-building memory.
